identity.gameplayFunction: communicate hit direction, damage severity and impact cause
identity.worldRole: A short-lived visual sentence that tells the player where the hit came from, what it struck and how severe the consequence is.
identity.manufactureContext: Not a physical manufactured object; it is a disciplined visual grammar attached to canonical impact anchors and state transitions.
identity.emotionalIntent: Punchy, satisfying and informative without obscuring the target, camera or next decision.
identity.territoryVisualThesis: A forceful graphic impact sentence whose large vector wedge, bent arc and two or three material-matched fragments preserve target visibility and frontier tactility.

instantRead.oneSecondPromise: A clear wedge, arc and few large fragments point back to the impact source and distinguish serious from critical damage.
instantRead.orientationCue: The dominant cone or wedge aligns with incoming force and terminates at the exact impact anchor.
instantRead.interactionCue: No interaction affordance is present; the effect only explains an event.
instantRead.dangerCue: Severity grows through angle, scale, fragmentation, timing and audio, never through hue alone.
instantRead.relationToPlayer: Neutral explanatory feedback that supports competence and post-failure understanding.

proportionRules: The effect remains inside a four-stud cube around the impact center.
The primary directional shape carries most visible area.
Only two or three large secondary fragments are allowed.
Residual smoke or sparks remain thin enough to preserve target readability.

views.front: A directional wedge and arc terminate at the impact center with few large fragments spreading along the force vector.
views.back: The source direction remains inferable through taper and fragment trail rather than a symmetric explosion.
views.left: The primary wedge shows depth and a clean origin-to-impact relationship.
views.right: The counter-profile confirms the same vector and avoids spherical fog.
views.top: A readable directional fan reveals hit angle without surrounding the target uniformly.
views.bottom: No decorative underside exists; any ground contact is a brief directional dust shape.
views.threeQuarterFront: The canonical view shows source vector, target contact, severity arc and limited fragments in one glance.
views.threeQuarterBack: The taper and residual trail preserve causality from the opposite side.
views.gameCamera: At mobile scale the effect reads as one arrow-like event sentence and disappears before it blocks the next decision.

negativeSpaces: open space opposite the impact vector
silhouette.intentionalAsymmetry: Twenty-four-percent controlled asymmetry expresses adaptation inside a seventy-five-to-eighty-five-percent standardized chassis; footprint, facing, collision promise, pivots and gameplay anchors remain fixed.
silhouette.distanceRule: The primary function, orientation and state must remain readable at 30 studs in the canonical mobile landscape and portrait views.

formHierarchy.territoryConstructionTranslation: The effect inherits Industrial-level shape economy and direction clarity, then expresses Salvaged Frontier through material-matched fragments, warm edge sparks and restrained dusty weight.

components.relationship: Anchored to the target contact and immediately yields to the directional shape.
components.visibility: Visible from all gameplay views for a very short interval.
components.readingRole: Pins the event to the correct target.

components.function: Communicate incoming force direction and primary severity.
components.relationship: Starts opposite the source and terminates at the impact anchor.
components.visibility: Dominant during the primary shape interval.
components.readingRole: Carries cause and direction before decorative fragments.

components.function: Reinforce material response and severity with a bounded fragment count.
components.relationship: Emerge from the impact anchor and never become persistent geometry.
components.visibility: Readable near and mid range, omitted when too small at far range.

components.function: Preserve causality briefly after the primary impact shape ends.
components.relationship: Fades from source vector toward the impact center.
components.readingRole: Allows a late glance to recover hit direction.

plausibilityRules: Every visible part belongs to a named component and has a functional relationship to at least one neighboring component.
No part floats, interpenetrates without an approved joint, or relies on unexplained support.
Moving, replaceable and destructible components preserve declared axes, anchors and clearance.
The compiler may simplify tertiary finish but may not remove a primary or secondary semantic component.
construction.stableNamingRule: Component IDs and gameplay anchors never change without an approved canon revision.

artDirection.territoryThesis: A hopeful fortress culture of intelligent survival: calm standardized chassis make every tool dependable, while one or two visible adaptations turn scarcity, repair and shared history into proud authorship without post-apocalyptic noise.
shapeGrammar: large protected apertures and explicit load-bearing joints
one localized offset brace or replacement module
visible replacement, reinforcement, sealing or rerouting logic
artDirection.exaggeration: Function, load paths, service access and the single authored adaptation are enlarged enough to read on mobile; distress, dirt and tiny mechanics never carry identity.
artDirection.edgeLanguage: Large consistent structural bevels create calm readable highlights; only the boundary of an approved repair may use a sharper cut or visibly renewed edge, and nothing becomes razor-thin.
artDirection.detailDensity: Low secondary construction density and extremely low tertiary density; seventy-two percent primary mass, twenty-three percent functional secondary structure and five percent causal finish.
artDirection.asymmetry: Twenty-four-percent controlled asymmetry expresses adaptation inside a seventy-five-to-eighty-five-percent standardized chassis; footprint, facing, collision promise, pivots and gameplay anchors remain fixed.
artDirection.materialLanguage: Deep coated structure, reclaimed composite panels, exposed durable metal, matte contacts and rare contextual wood surround carefully protected interaction technology.
artDirection.paletteLogic: Deep slate and bone-sand create a quiet frontier base; sun-baked copper identifies player intervention, while mint interaction, raspberry threat, gold warning and red critical remain bounded semantic roles.
artDirection.surfaceTreatment: Broad calm planes, one or two patch boundaries and directional abrasion tell a construction history without uniform grime, material roulette or photoreal texture chatter.
artDirection.wearLogic: Every scar must name a cause: prior impact, heat, hand contact, ground abrasion or an approved repair operation; damage widens one causal chain and repair reverses it.
signatureDetails: two or three material-matched heavy fragments
forbidden: decorative repair with no causal reason
more than three visible material families
literal construction-toy motifs or pristine molded-plastic identity
